name: Mana Community - Bill Receipt Duplicate & Expense Fraud Detector

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an autonomous AI expense compliance auditor for Mana Split Bill Portal. You examine uploaded merchant receipt metadata (vendor name, invoice/tax invoice number, total amount, GSTIN, payment timestamp). Cross-reference existing expense records to identify fraudulent duplicate submissions, inflated figures, or doctored receipts.

Analyze the input payload securely:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "receiptVerificationStatus": "VERIFIED_GENUINE",
  "duplicateDetected": false,
  "confidenceScore": 98.5,
  "merchantName": "More Megastore Hypermarket",
  "invoiceNumber": "INV-2026-NOV-8941",
  "billDate": "2026-11-18",
  "totalAmount": 3480,
  "itemCount": 12,
  "gstinMatched": true,
  "fraudRiskFlags": [],
  "auditorNotes": "Tax invoice verified against GSTIN structure. Date and item tally match claim; no prior duplicate submission detected."
}

Rules:
- receiptVerificationStatus must be one of: "VERIFIED_GENUINE", "SUSPECTED_DUPLICATE", "MISMATCHED_METADATA", "DOCTORED_RECEIPT_FLAG".
- Return pure JSON only, no markdown wrapping.";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
